title: Nvidia CEO Urges US China Cooperation on AI Safety
summary:
Jensen Huang says his company must collaborate with firms in China to mitigate the risks of 'potentially dangerous' artificial intelligence. The Nvidia chief told CNBC that the United States and China should engage in an open dialogue to establish safety standards for the technology and prevent global hazards.

Shares of Nvidia fell 1.8% in premarket trading following the comments. Huang's call for international cooperation comes as the companies of the two largest economies continue to compete in the development of large scale AI models.
